messages.subject: Error running SUMMER vignette
parts:
Hi, 

I am trying to replicate the SUMMER vignette found here: https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/SUMMER/vignettes/summer-vignette.html 

However, when try to run the model with the area-level covariates, i.e. 

svysmoothed_with_covariate <- smoothSurvey(data = BRFSS, geo = KingCounty, Amat = mat, X = Education, responseType = "binary", responseVar="diab2", strataVar="strata", weightVar="rwt_llcp", regionVar="hracode", clusterVar = "~1", CI = 0.95)


I get the following error:
Error in if (fixed %in% colnames(dat)) { : the condition has length > 1 

I am using R-4.2.1, RStudio, Windows.

Thank you!
Beth
